$comment: Shot list entry (sand-y0u.6): the manifest is ahead of the binary. The image has NOT been fetched yet — run the download in docs/imagery-phase-1.md, then `npm run media`. Provenance verified against the archive record on 2026-08-24.

original.description: French field artillery leaving Paris, 9 August 1914. Catalogued by the Bibliothèque nationale de France as "9-8-14, la mobilisation, départ de l’artillerie : [photographie de presse]", with the subject headings "Militaires français; Artillerie -- France; Canons; France. Armée -- Mobilisation" and the coverage date 9 August 1914.
original.photographer: Agence Rol (press agency; the operator is not named)
original.archive: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Agence Rol collection, reference Rol 41721; digitised on Gallica (btv1b6931160m), via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; UsageTerms "Public domain"). Credit line on the record: Bibliothèque nationale de France.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize — the gunners’ dark blue tunics and madder trousers and the grey-green of the 75 are documented, and the firepower card has no French colour at all.

content_policy: ok — guns and teams in a street, no gore
caption: French field artillery leaving Paris, 9 August 1914. The 75 was the best field gun in Europe and the reason the French army thought it did not need heavy artillery.
credit: Original photograph: Agence Rol, Paris, 9 August 1914; Bibliothèque nationale de France, Rol 41721, via Gallica and Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. The caption should not claim the guns in frame are 75s unless the image review confirms it — the archive record says "artillerie", not the model.
